description: Land Acquisition - Nattha, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring the government's intention to acquire multiple land lots (Lots 94-185) for the Central Expressway Project. The content details specific land parcels, their descriptions (estate, road, garden, canal), extents, and claimants, making it exclusively about land and property matters. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land acquisitions and disposals.
